Outline layers drawn beneath all cells

Source: R/zzz.R
outline_layers.Rd

A coloured layer then a background-coloured layer slightly larger than the points, drawn beneath all cells, give the cell clouds a crisp border.

Usage

outline_layers(df, pt.size, outline.size, outline.color, halo.color, layer_fun)

Arguments

df

Plotted cells

pt.size

Point size

outline.size

Thickness of the outline

outline.color

A single colour, or one colour per row of `df`

halo.color

Colour of the gap between the outline and the cells

layer_fun

Function wrapping point layers, from points_layer_fun

Value

A list of two layers
